lt;sup>a</sup> Population derived by interpolating for each year between 1970 census population and 1975 estimate and assuming an equal increase in 1976.
Source: Mountain West Research Inc. derived from "County Clerk Annual Report to State Examiner" for each county. 1975 and 1976 figures received by telephone interview with Big Horn County Clerk and County Assessor.
Between 1972 and 1976 per capita expenditures and taxable valuation for Big Horn County rose significantly while the percentage of expenditures financed by property tax and the mill levy decreased significantly. During the same period the city of Hardin also experienced significant increases in expenditures and more modest increases in taxable evaluation with a decrease in expenditures financed by property taxes. However, their mill levy increased by approximately 36 percent.
